ModMetaData.name: Waylith Leak Repro
ModMetaData.author: CI
ModMetaData.description:
Minimal mod built by ci/make_leak_mod.py for the extension-leak experiment.
Two texture folders under the same def layout: LeakPlain : UniqueRevolverA..E.png + A..E_m.png (a normal loose-PNG mod) LeakExt : UniqueRevolverA..E.png.png + A..E_m.png.png (the asset name keeps the inner .png)
The defs exist only to point Graphic_Random at those folders. No code, no Harmony.
